Class StripeWebhookIntegrationService

@RestResource(urlMapping='/stripe/v1/webhook')
global without sharing class StripeWebhookIntegrationService

REST service for handling Stripe webhook events. Validates incoming webhook signatures, processes events based on their type, and saves records using dynamically-defined mappings from ReplicationSettings__mdt. Supports post-processing methods for additional business logic after record creation.

Methods

@HttpPost
global static void handle()

Handles incoming Stripe webhook events via HTTP POST. Validates the Stripe-Signature header, verifies the event is from a production environment (if in production org), checks if the event type is supported via ReplicationSettings__mdt, saves the record using StripeWebhookIntegrationHelper, and executes any post-processing methods defined in the replication settings. Returns appropriate HTTP status codes based on validation and processing results.
